report_meta.executive_summary: Two findings: a confirmed, exploited reflected XSS and an analysis-only authorization gap awaiting independent verification.

findings.title: Reflected XSS in search query parameter
findings.overview: The `q` parameter on /search is reflected unencoded into the page HTML, allowing script injection.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled script executes in the victim's browser session.
findings.remediation: HTML-encode the reflected value before writing it into the page.

proof_of_impact.text: The script executed and raised an alert.

findings.title: Missing authorization check on internal admin endpoint
findings.overview: GET /internal/admin/users appears to return user data without verifying the caller has an admin role.
findings.impact: An unauthenticated or low-privilege user could enumerate all user records.
findings.remediation: Enforce an admin-role check on this route before returning data.
